name: ML Model Selection Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative expansion and refinement inventory for reusable Kaggle-style ML pipeline adaptations.

operations.name: K-Fold Cross-Validated Ensemble
operations.intent: Replace one-shot model training with fold-safe training that produces multiple models and out-of-fold predictions.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train one model per fold so validation is fair and later stacking can use out-of-fold predictions.

rewrite.before_summary: A single model-training stage feeds prediction or ensembling directly.
rewrite.after_summary: The model-training stage is replaced by fold splitting followed by per-fold model training.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves the train-to-predict contract while adding leakage-safe validation artifacts and out-of-fold predictions.
notes: Use a grouped or time-aware splitter when the planning artifact declares grouped or temporal leakage risk.

uncertainty_notes: This operation changes validation structure but should preserve the downstream prediction contract.

operations.name: Two-Level Stacking
operations.intent: Replace a flat prediction ensemble with a two-level meta-learner over out-of-fold predictions.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use the first-level models' validation predictions as features for a simple second-level model.

rewrite.before_summary: A flat prediction ensemble consumes model outputs directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Out-of-fold predictions are collected into meta-features, a simple meta-learner is trained, and final predictions are produced through that meta-learner.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction output shape while adding a second-level aggregation model.
notes: The meta-learner should remain simple to avoid overfitting the stacking layer.

uncertainty_notes: This operation is only justified when out-of-fold predictions or diverse level-one models are available.

operations.name: Constraint Injection
operations.intent: Insert explicit verification and correction when predictions must satisfy fairness, decorrelation, or invariance constraints.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether predictions violate a declared constraint and add a correction step when they do.

rewrite.before_summary: Model predictions flow directly into the prediction ensemble.
rewrite.after_summary: A constraint verification stage and correction stage are inserted before ensembling.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction semantics while making constraint satisfaction explicit and auditable.
notes: This operation is appropriate for decorrelation, fairness, and physics-invariance requirements.

uncertainty_notes: Post-hoc correction can trade off leaderboard metric performance against constraint satisfaction.

operations.name: Deep Learning Backbone Substitution
operations.intent: Rewrite manual feature engineering plus shallow model training into pretrained-backbone finetuning.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a pretrained image, text, or multimodal backbone instead of hand-built features when the modality calls for transfer learning.

rewrite.before_summary: Feature engineering feeds a generic model-training stage.
rewrite.after_summary: A pretrained backbone is loaded, finetuned, and optionally evaluated with test-time augmentation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Replaces handcrafted representations with learned transfer representations while preserving downstream prediction artifacts.
notes: This is a topology rewrite, not a small post-processing insertion.

uncertainty_notes: This operation should be gated by modality or an explicit transfer-learning recommendation.

audit.rationale: Normalizes the existing ML skeleton expansion CDGs into the provider expansion asset schema consumed by the shared expansion engine.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable ML pipeline changes such as k-fold training, stacking, constraints, and pretrained backbones now use the same expansion schema as other provider operations.

migration_readiness.rationale: The operations are now declared through data/expansions and backed by matcher runtime rules.

uncertainty_notes: The legacy skeleton expansion CDGs remain as source material until all downstream readers consume ExpansionFamilyAsset directly.
